content_sections.heading: IIITD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Junior Support Assistant (Senior Admin Office) supports the Senior Administrative Officer. The roles and responsibilities printed in the notice are: Assist the Senior Administrative Officer in coordinating administrative matters with various Departments and administrative sections of the Institute. Monitor the progress of matters referred to different administrative units and ensure timely submission of cases. Coordinate with concerned officers/officials for implementation of decisions and directions of the competent authorities. Assist in preparation and processing of agenda items for meetings of the Board of Governors, Senate, Finance Committee and other statutory/Institute committees. Assist in preparation, circulation and maintenance of minutes and records of meetings. Follow up on decisions taken by statutory bodies and ensure timely compliance by the concerned sections. Assist in ensuring compliance with the Institute Act, Statutes, Institute Rules, Regulations, Ordinances, Government of India instructions and other applicable statutory provisions. Examine administrative cases with reference to applicable rules and submit appropriate proposals for consideration of the competent authority. Assist in updating and maintaining records of Institute rules, orders, notifications and administrative instructions. Coordinate the preparation and submission of replies to DTTE, Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha questions, including Starred and Unstarred Questions, in consultation with the concerned Departments/Sections. Obtain, compile and verify the requisite information from the concerned Departments/Sections and ensure submission of replies within the prescribed timelines. Maintain proper records of Parliamentary questions, Government references and replies submitted thereto, and monitor subsequent follow-up action, wherever required. Maintain and monitor important records, files, registers and correspondence pertaining to the Office. Assist in drafting office orders, circulars, notifications, letters, notes and other official communications. Ensure proper filing, indexing, digitization and preservation of important administrative records. Handle confidential files, correspondence and information relating to personnel, legal, disciplinary and other sensitive administrative matters with due care and confidentiality. Perform any other administrative, coordination or related duties as may be assigned by the competent authority from time to time. The notice says these responsibilities are indicative and may be modified or expanded depending upon the functional requirements of the Officer.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for IIITD Junior Support Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for applying is 31 October 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for IIITD Junior Support Assistant (Senior Admin Office)?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Any Graduate/Post Graduate having 3 years' experience of Administration & HR, with a minimum of 1 year of relevant administrative experience in a university, higher education institute, or research organization. MBA (HR) will be preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of IIITD Junior Support Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is ₹30,000/- to ₹40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How to apply for IIITD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates share a detailed CV on [email protected] before 31 October 2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What subject line should be used in the email?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application For The Post Of Junior Support Assistant (Senior Admin Office)". Emails without the subject line will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IIITD Junior Support Assistant?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for the further selection process, and no other mode of communication will be entertained.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIITD Junior Support Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract position on third-party payroll for a duration of one year, extendable on a performance basis.

faq.question: Q8. Is an MBA (HR) compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: No. MBA (HR) will be preferred, while the required qualification is Any Graduate/Post Graduate with 3 years' experience of Administration & HR. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi are desirable.
